hooks.command: b=$(head -n 1 "${HIPPO_HOME:-$HOME/.hippo}/bin-path" 2>/dev/null); case $b in /*) [ -x "$b" ] || b= ;; *) b= ;; esac; if [ -z "$b" ]; then PATH="$PATH:$HOME/.local/bin:$HOME/.cargo/bin"; b=$(command -v hippo 2>/dev/null); fi; [ -n "$b" ] && "$b" hook session-start --plugin 2>/dev/null; exit 0
